# altr

> AI enablement and automation firm in Tampa, Florida. We help growing teams use AI
> inside the work they already own, then automate the repeated parts. Founded by
> Alex Britton and Jarred Robidoux. Serving Tampa, St. Petersburg, Clearwater, and
> remote clients.

Contact: inquiries@altrwork.com

## Pricing

- [What we do and what it costs](https://altrwork.com/what-we-do.html): three engagements in a fixed
  order, no separate charge for the intro call. Every engagement starts with enablement: four hours
  from $3,500, run against the team's own tools and spread however the team wants. Enablement comes
  in two formats at the same price, because the price reflects depth rather than headcount. A working
  session is hands-on with the one to four people who own a process, and returns a written map of
  that workflow plus prompts built against real files. A team workshop covers up to ten people more
  broadly and is less hands-on with each person; everyone leaves with something running, but there is
  no per-person map. Office-wide rollouts and longer formats are quoted from there. Enablement output
  is prompts and workflows the team runs by hand. Agent build and deployment is quoted as one fixed
  fee against written scope after enablement, with hours named per workstream; no build price is
  published because scope sets it, and the scope comes from the map enablement produced. A build means
  software engineering: multi-step agent orchestrations that act autonomously, MCP servers wiring
  agents into existing tools and permissions, deployed and monitored rather than run by hand.
  Consulting retainer is up to ten hours a month of advisory time and is only available after an
  enablement engagement or a build; it is not an entry point. $2,400 month to month, $2,200/month on a
  three-month term, or $2,000/month on six months; unused hours roll one month. Retainer hours are
  advisory, not a build slot and not embedded headcount. Model and infrastructure costs are billed by
  vendors directly to the client, typically $25-$250/month at pilot volume.

## Services

- [AI consulting in Tampa](https://altrwork.com/ai-consulting-tampa.html): local service overview and common questions
- [Workflow discovery](https://altrwork.com/workflow-audit.html): mapping one repeated process before anything is built
- [AI enablement](https://altrwork.com/ai-enablement-workshop.html): hands-on work against a team's own tasks, as a small-group working session or a full team workshop
- [Custom AI agents](https://altrwork.com/custom-agents.html): workflow agents, agentic coding systems, automation handoff
- [Forward deployed engineering](https://altrwork.com/forward-deployed-engineering.html): the method behind our engagements, building inside the operating context; not sold separately as embedded headcount or engineer-days
- [Events](https://altrwork.com/events.html): workshops, community demos, workflow reviews

## Impact studies

- [spARK Labs, operations intake](https://altrwork.com/impact-spark-labs.html): expense and event request workflows in Claude Cowork
- [spARK Labs, remote MCP server](https://altrwork.com/impact-spark-labs-mcp.html): Cloudflare Workers MCP server connecting Claude to operations tools
- [Fishin Prints](https://altrwork.com/impact-fishin-prints.html): catch photo to print-ready artwork workflow
- [BeBrief](https://altrwork.com/impact-bebrief.html): coding agents inside a full-stack build process

## Real estate field guide

- [AI in Real Estate: From Chatbot to Operating Layer](https://altrwork.com/ai-in-real-estate-guide.html): free 12-page guide to playbooks, connected systems, local file work, recurring routines, workflow readiness, and a 30-day pilot plan
- [Claude in CRE: Skills](https://altrwork.com/claude-cre-skills.html): packaging underwriting context and steps into a reusable playbook
- [Claude in CRE: Connectors](https://altrwork.com/claude-cre-connectors.html): connecting AI to CRM, property systems, and local market data
- [Claude in CRE: Cowork](https://altrwork.com/claude-cre-cowork.html): working directly inside approved local underwriting files
- [Claude in CRE: Scheduled Tasks](https://altrwork.com/claude-cre-scheduled-tasks.html): recurring market, pipeline, and property routines
